lesson.introText:
Hey guys! I’m BUDDY! Today, we’ll practice two vowels that sound the same to us, but not to a native. They’re... …/ʌ/ and /ɝ/! Listen: cup is short, bird is long: bird

In cup, much and sunny the sound is short and open. It’s /ʌ/. In bird, work and learn the sound is longer, with the tongue pulled back.
